## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation (10/11 sectors positive) supports risk-on tilt; Confirmation 2: large-cap tech weakness (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND) creates mixed signals, justifying NEUTRAL.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: RCL (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, SBUX (1W: +8.13% | 1M: -2.18%) RECOVERY. Financials strong: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND, supporting cyclical participation.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND. Technology shows internal bifurcation with mega-cap weakness—AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND despite strength in semiconductors.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +15.32% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -4.42% | 1M: +26.84%) CORRECTION, ACN (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -5.54% | 1M: +1.75%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap software and select tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +25.61%), AMAT (1W: +25.22%), LRCX (1W: +20.95%), RCL (1W: +15.32%). Watch SBUX (1W: +8.13% | 1M: -2.18%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY for follow-through versus month trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: semiconductors leading (INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND) while mega-cap software and ad platforms lag (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND). Sector performance: Technology (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +4.73%) (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Healthy cyclicals: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND and sectorwide strength (Financials 1W: +3.29% | 1M: +5.82%). Payments mixed: V (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND—monitor earnings/flows.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Modestly positive: JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Watch headline risk after mixed news (ISRG -60; AMGN +50/-55) for stock-specific volatility.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to semiconductors and cyclical financials given narrow but powerful semiconductor leadership (INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to large-cap software and ad-exposed names showing sustained weakness (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND) and monitor NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +9.35%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical continuation. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside or capitulation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +5.90%) and Financials (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +5.82%) on rotation into cyclicals. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +1.36%) and large-cap Tech software names as a group.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY — needs decisive weekly follow-through above recent highs to signal sustained reversal. AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND — breach of near-term support would extend weakness. INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND — gap-fill / follow-through above this week’s range confirms leader status.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (+45): XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price is diverging, monitor for accumulation. HON (+60) and AMGN (+50) flagged bullish in news but lacking short-term timeframes here; watch HON and AMGN headlines for confirmation versus price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned, downside risk elevated. ACN (-50): ACN (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION — news confirming short-term pullback despite longer monthly strength. CVX (-45): CVX (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +1.58%) CORRECTION — news aligns with near-term pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow semiconductor strength versus large-cap tech weakness. INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology)) and divergences in mega-cap software (AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND) plus XOM bullish headlines while price remains BELOW TREND.
